summary: Competitors cluster around speed or aesthetics, with limited emphasis on governance, auditability, or disciplined operational workflows.

findings.title: Speed-first messaging dominates
findings.detail: At least one competitor markets speed as the primary differentiator, with limited discussion of governance or audit controls.

findings.title: Polish without operational depth
findings.detail: Another competitor leads with design polish but appears to lack robust operational tooling for repeatable, governed execution.
